definitions.explanation: Acting or doing something slowly and without energy or motivation. Often implies wasting time.
Liquid flowing continuously in a slow stream.

notes:
だらだら is an onomatopoeic word with two main uses. The more common sense describes lazy, aimless, or drawn-out behavior, often with a negative connotation of wasting time. The second sense describes liquid dripping or trickling slowly and continuously.

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 1 — lazily):
- だらだら⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time lazily
- だらだら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧: to drag on
- だらだら⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to laze around, to be idle
- だらだら⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to go on and on without purpose

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 2 — dripping):
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だらだら⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: sweat dripping down
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だらだら⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: blood trickling continuously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きびきび→きびきび：05842_kibikibi⟧: briskly, energetically (opposite of sense 1)
- ⟦てきぱき→てきぱき：05649_tekipaki⟧: efficiently, promptly (opposite of sense 1)
- ⟦ぽたぽた→ぽたぽた：05715_potapota⟧: drip-drip (drops falling one by one, vs. だらだら's continuous flow)
